design_gotchas.title: 5.5 V Max Supply Limit vs Pin-Identical High-Voltage SOIC-8 Op-Amps
design_gotchas.detail: TLV9002IDR shares the standard 8-pin SOIC dual op-amp pinout with LM358DR (30 V), MC33202DR2G (12 V), and TL072IDR (40 V), making it a clean RRIO CMOS upgrade on 1.8 V–5.5 V rails, but it will suffer immediate permanent damage above its 7 V absolute maximum on 9 V, 12 V, or ±15 V boards.

design_gotchas.title: Higher SOIC-8 Thermal Resistance (207.9 °C/W) Under Heavy Load
design_gotchas.detail: TI revised TLV9002 SOIC-8 RθJA upward to 207.9 °C/W (from 147.4 °C/W in earlier revisions). When both channels source or sink tens of milliamps at high ambient temperatures (up to 125°C), verify junction temperature stays below TJ,max = 150°C.

design_gotchas.title: RRIO Input Crossover CMRR Step Near (V+) - 1.4 V
design_gotchas.detail: Typical CMRR drops from 95 dB for VCM < (V+) - 1.4 V down to 77 dB typ (63 dB min) across the full rail-to-rail input range as the complementary input stages transition.

design_gotchas.title: High 1200 Ω Open-Loop Output Impedance at 1 MHz
design_gotchas.detail: The resistive 1200 Ω open-loop output impedance stabilizes capacitive loads up to 500 pF directly, but limits high-frequency drive stiffness into low-impedance loads near unity-gain bandwidth.

typical_use_cases: 3.3 V / 5 V true-RRIO CMOS upgrade for LMV358IDR and low-voltage LM358DR sockets
Battery-powered dual-channel sensor signal conditioning and wearable front-ends
High-impedance pH, gas, and photodiode conditioning requiring 5 pA input bias
Low-side current sensing and active filtering on 1.8 V–5.5 V MCU rails
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments TLV9002IDR is a dual, low-power (60 µA/ch typ), 1 MHz, 2 V/µs rail-to-rail input and output (RRIO) CMOS operational amplifier in an 8-pin SOIC (D) package operating from 1.8 V to 5.5 V (7 V abs max) across -40°C to 125°C. Sharing the industry-standard dual SOIC-8 pinout with LMV358IDR and LM358DR, it delivers true RRIO operation with no phase reversal, ±1.6 mV max offset, 5 pA input bias current, integrated RFI/EMI filters, and 500 pF capacitive-load drive—making it a premier modern low-voltage replacement where rails do not exceed 5.5 V.
